The '''Desert of Kariste''' was a relatively small, barren wasteland located on the rugged [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Sevarcos II|Sevarcos]]. It was situated between the [[Arrandle Mountains|Arrandle]] and [[Trekali Mountains|Trekali Mountain]] ranges.<ref name="HNNA">{{JournalCite|12|Heroes Need Not Apply}}</ref>
